basic_info.description: Discover the charm of this stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in the heart of San Franciscos vibrant SoMa neighborhood. With Muni and BART right at your doorstep and downtown just a short stroll away, convenience is at your fingertips. Spanning 998 sq ft, this residence offers a thoughtfully designed living space. The kitchen is a dream for any home chef, boasting granite countertops and customized cabinets. The open-concept dining area seamlessly connects to the living room, making it perfect for entertaining. A blend of Oak flooring and carpet flooring add to the homes sophisticated ambiance. The inviting living room provides a cozy retreat, while the primary suite features a spacious walk-in closet for ample storage. Enjoy the ease of in-unit laundry. A dedicated garage parking space is also included. Located in the boutique OneEleven condo complex, residents enjoy access to an expansive rooftop with a BBQ island, and stunning city skyline views. Additional amenities include a secure package room, bike storage, and an exclusive resident lobby. Dont miss the chance to make this exceptional home yours!
